description: The plot illustrates how a measured value (y-axis) varies with the “Number of Tokens” (x-axis) for four data sources: Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Tokens,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 200 to 1000 tokens with labeled ticks at 200, 400, 600, and 800 (the rightmost point at 1000 is plotted but not labeled). The y-axis uses a linear scale and ranges from 10 to 40 with labeled ticks at 10-unit intervals (10, 20, 30, 40). The Tutorials series is shown as a blue solid line with circular markers, increasing from about 23 at 200 tokens to ~27 at 500, ~29 at 800, and ending near ~29 at 1000. The Library Documentation series is a red solid line with circular markers, rising from ~26 at 200 to ~29 at 500 and ~32 at 800, then decreasing to ~27 at 1000. The StackOverflow posts series is an orange/yellow solid line with circular markers, starting around ~33 at 200, slightly decreasing to ~30 at 500, then dropping to ~19 at 800 and ~11 at 1000. The Github files series is a green solid line with circular markers, increasing from ~28 at 200 to ~30 at 500 and ~33 at 800, then decreasing to ~30 at 1000.
